name: @engenox/verifier
description: The re-grounding checks — the candor gate the control-plane runs on every seam output BEFORE it touches the spine (11 §2c: the verifier re-grounds every claim). Pure functions: takes a seam response + the known ground truth + returns a typed Verdict (Grounded / Ungrounded + the reasons). An extracted assertion referencing a non-known entity is rejected; a drafted schema.org JSON-LD artifact that does not parse is rejected — the gateway's raw JSON is refined by the verifier at the system boundary (22 §3, the sanctioned `unknown` refinement), never trusted blind. NO I/O; NO service imports (24 §3: libs sit below the service layer).
